manifest.name: dsh-hide-empty-workspace
manifest.description: 【已停止维护】官方 DSH 侧栏已内置「工作区没有可见会话就不渲染该行」，本插件的自动隐藏是重复实现。历史功能：最后一个未归档会话被归档时隐藏该工作区行，另在工作区行「…」菜单里追加「隐藏工作区」并配官方 Modal 恢复入口；只切 display，不归档、不删除、不改写任何工作区注册与会话数据。
manifest.author: d0ublecl1ck

bundle.text:
# A bundle layer: applied in dsh.profile.bundles order, overridden by id
# from later bundle layers and from the profile/user patch files.
- insert:
    - id: hide-empty-workspace
      name: "dsh-hide-empty-workspace"

readme.text: 🌐 中文 · English

> *「把最后一个会话归档的那一刻，那个空工作区自己从侧栏消失了。」* [](LICENSE) > [!WARNING] > **本仓库已停止维护（2026-10-24）。** > DSH 官方侧栏已内置同样的能力：工作区没有可见会话时，这一行根本不会渲染。插件的自动隐藏因此是重复实现，也不再跟进官方 UI 改版。新装不必再装，已装可按下方说明卸载。 **侧栏的自动瘦身。它只在这条规则成立时动手：某个工作区的未归档会话从 `1+` 掉到 `0`。它不归档、不删除、不改写工作区注册，唯一会写的是浏览器里的隐藏集合。** [它解决什么问题](#它解决什么问题) · [效果示例](#效果示例) · [停止维护](#停止维护) · [安装（历史留档）](#安装历史留档) · [触发方式](#触发方式) · [安全边界](#安全边界) · [文件结构](#文件结构) ---

归档是 DSH 里一个**手动动作**，而「这个工作区已经空了」没有人替你判断。

于是侧栏总是这样烂掉：你随手给某个项目开过一两次会话，用过就归档掉，可那个工作区还留在列表里——没有会话，也不再有用，只是在那里占一行。攒到十几个之后，真正在用的那几个被挤到了下面。

这个插件把「空了」变成一个**被动触发的清理信号**：某工作区的未归档会话数从 `1+` 掉到 `0` 的那一刻，它的侧栏行自动隐藏。

**它只在那一刻动手。** 手动隐藏在任一工作区行自己的「…」菜单里；恢复入口在侧栏底部。插件不接管任何状态。
上图是侧栏一列的截图，工作区名已隐去。连着隐藏两个工作区时只有一个变成 `display:none`——另一个是「正在使用的工作区」，按设计保持可见。

官方侧栏（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace`）已经自带这条规则：工作区过滤后可见会话数为 `0` 时整行不渲染；空白会话只保留当前选中的那一条。也就是说：

- **自动隐藏**：官方已覆盖，本插件这部分是重复实现——插件在 DOM 上再补一次 `display:none`。
- **手动隐藏与「已隐藏 N」恢复**：官方没有对应入口，但本仓库不再维护，也不会跟进官方改版。
- **建议**：不新装；已安装的执行 `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-hide-empty-workspace`，工作区可见性交回官方侧栏。

本仓库保留只作历史记录，不再发版、不再修 bug。

以下命令只对仍在使用本插件的人有效；新装请直接使用官方侧栏。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-hide-empty-workspace

readme.section: 或直接从 GitHub 装（不需要 npm 账号，也不等镜像同步）
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile web add https://codeload.github.com/d0ublecl1ck/dsh-hide-empty-workspace/tar.gz/refs/heads/main

readme.section: 本地改代码时，把它以路径形式加进 profile
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add /绝对路径/dsh-hide-empty-workspace
```

`dsh plugin add` 会在 profile 目录里同时写入 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 两处，装完刷新页面即可。

<details>sh
DSH_HOME="$HOME/Library/Application Support/dsh-desktop/harness" \
  "$DSH_HOME/.desktop-bin/node" \
  "/Applications/DSH Desktop.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar.unpacked/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js" \
  plugin --profile web add /绝对路径/dsh-hide-empty-workspace
```

Windows 上把路径换成本机对应位置即可，参数不变。
</details>

- **自动**：你把某个工作区的最后一个未归档会话归档掉 → 它的行隐藏。
- **手动**：悬停任意工作区行，点行内「…」菜单里的「隐藏工作区」。任何情况下都立即隐藏。
- **恢复**：点侧栏底部的「已隐藏 N」→ 打开官方对话框 → 逐个「恢复」，恢复完自动关闭。
- **自动恢复**：某个被隐藏的工作区重新有了未归档会话 → 自动取消隐藏。

不会触发的情况：

- **刚添加的工作区**：插件只记录、不隐藏；如果它没有可见会话，官方侧栏本来就不会渲染这一行，那是官方行为，与本插件无关。
- **正在使用的工作区**：即使满足隐藏条件也保持可见（隐藏两个工作区时实测只有一个变成 `display:none`，另一个就是它）。
- **「未分组」桶**：永不隐藏。

- **不归档、不取消归档、不删除**任何会话或工作区。
- **不改写工作区注册**：不动 `workspaces` 服务，不动 `settings.yaml`。
- **不联网**：插件不发任何请求。
- **唯一写入**是浏览器 `localStorage` 里的隐藏集合（键 `dsh-hide-empty-workspace.hidden.v1`）。清掉它，一切恢复原样。
- **不替换官方 UI**：只在官方已经渲染好的行上切 `display`，在工作区行自带的「…」菜单里追加一项，恢复入口用官方 `Modal`；不接管、不重绘官方组件。官方改版导致找不到行时，它不再默默无闻——侧栏底部会出现 `⚠ 工作区行标记失配，插件未生效`；但侧栏收成 rail（窄窗口自动收起）或切到「分组方式 → 单列表」时本就不渲染工作区行，自检保持安静。

```text
index.js                    宿主半边（本插件不需要宿主能力，占位 apply）
client.js                   浏览器半边：判定、行菜单项注入、官方 Modal 恢复入口、自检
cordis.patch.yml            bundle 层，声明插入本插件
tests/hidden-workspaces.test.mjs   28 条纯函数单测
🌐 中文 · English

> *"The moment you archive its last session, the empty workspace removes itself from the sidebar."*

[](LICENSE)

> [!WARNING]
> **This repository is no longer maintained (2026-10-24).**
> The shipped DSH sidebar now does the same job: a workspace with no visible sessions is never rendered at all. The plugin's automatic hiding is therefore a duplicate implementation, and it no longer tracks upstream UI changes. Do not install it; existing installs can be removed as described below.

**Automatic sidebar housekeeping. It acts on exactly one rule: a workspace's unarchived session count drops from `1+` to `0`. It never archives, deletes or rewrites workspaces — the only thing it writes is a hidden-set in your browser.** [The problem](#the-problem) · [What it looks like](#what-it-looks-like) · [Maintenance status](#maintenance-status) · [Install (archived)](#install-archived) · [When it fires](#when-it-fires) · [Safety](#safety) · [Layout](#layout) ---

Archiving is a manual action in DSH, and nobody tells you that a workspace has gone empty.

So the sidebar rots: you open one or two sessions in a project, archive them when you are done, and the workspace itself stays — no sessions, no purpose, one more row. After a dozen of those, the workspaces you actually use have been pushed below the fold.

This plugin turns "it is empty now" into a passive signal: the moment a workspace's unarchived session count falls from `1+` to `0`, its sidebar row hides itself.

**That moment is the only moment it acts on its own.** Manual hiding lives in each workspace row's own "..." menu, and the restore entry sits at the bottom of the sidebar. The plugin owns no state.

The frame above is clipped to the sidebar column, with workspace names redacted. Hiding two workspaces in a row leaves exactly one at `display:none` — the other is the workspace currently in use, which stays visible by design.

The shipped sidebar (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace`) already applies this rule: a workspace whose visible session count filters down to `0` is not rendered at all, and a blank session is visible only while it is the selected one. In practice:

- **Automatic hiding**: covered upstream; this plugin's half is a duplicate — it re-applies `display:none` on the DOM.
- **Manual hiding and the "已隐藏 N" restore entry**: upstream has no equivalent, but this repository is no longer maintained and will not track upstream changes.
- **Recommendation**: do not install it; if you already have it, run `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-hide-empty-workspace` and let the shipped sidebar own workspace visibility.
This repository is kept for the record only: no new releases, no bug fixes.

These commands only matter if you still run the plugin; for new setups use the shipped sidebar.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-hide-empty-workspace

readme.section: or straight from GitHub (no npm account, no mirror sync wait)
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile web add https://codeload.github.com/d0ublecl1ck/dsh-hide-empty-workspace/tar.gz/refs/heads/main

readme.section: while editing the source, link the working copy instead
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/dsh-hide-empty-workspace
```

`dsh plugin add` writes both `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile, so a page refresh is enough.

- **Automatic**: you archive a workspace's last unarchived session → its row hides.
- **Manual**: hover any workspace row and pick "隐藏工作区" from its "..." menu.
- **Restore**: click the "已隐藏 N" entry at the bottom of the sidebar, then the shipped dialog opens and each "恢复" button restores one workspace; the dialog closes itself when none are left.
- **Automatic restore**: a hidden workspace gains an unarchived session again → it reappears.

It will not fire for:

- **A freshly added workspace.** The plugin only records it, never hides it; if it has no visible sessions, the shipped sidebar does not render the row anyway — that is upstream behavior, not this plugin.
- **The workspace in use**, which stays visible even when it matches the rule.
- **The "ungrouped" bucket**, which is never hidden.

- **Never archives, unarchives or deletes** any session or workspace.
- **Never rewrites the workspace registry**: it does not touch the `workspaces` service or `settings.yaml`.
- **Never talks to the network.**
- **The only write** is a hidden-set in browser `localStorage` (`dsh-hide-empty-workspace.hidden.v1`). Clear it and everything is back.
- **Never replaces the official UI**: it only toggles `display` on rows the shell already rendered, appends one entry to the row's own "..." menu, and opens the shipped `Modal` for restores; it does not take over or redraw any shipped component. If a DSH upgrade removes those rows it will not fail silently — the sidebar footer shows `⚠ 工作区行标记失配，插件未生效`. When the sidebar is collapsed into its rail (auto-collapse in a narrow window) or switched to the single-list grouping, no workspace row is rendered by design, so the self-check stays quiet.

client.js                   browser half: the rule, the row-menu entry, the shipped-Modal restore dialog, the self-check
cordis.patch.yml            the bundle layer that inserts this plugin
